stemMd: Which change did the volunteers introduce?

options.label: B
options.textMd: They accepted only seeds grown in identical soil.

options.label: C
options.textMd: They required every packet to be professionally certified.

options.label: D
options.textMd: They guaranteed that every seed would germinate.

options.label: E
options.textMd: They invited donors to record growing conditions and collection timing.

explanationMd: The passage names soil, watering and collection season as added records. These help interpretation rather than certify outcomes. Optional records and a beginner version show that participation was still intended to be accessible.

distractorRationale.c: The exchange is explicitly contrasted with certified products.
distractorRationale.a: A short form was kept for beginners.
distractorRationale.d: The text states that information did not guarantee success.
